LESSON: WRITING 2.4.1 CREATIVE WRITING: OPEN ENDED COMPOSITIONS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.4: Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing: Open ended Compositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing: Open ended Compositions, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: How do we express ideas on different topics? 2. Why do we share ideas?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing: Open ended Compositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: articulating signs clearly as learners discuss as they sign possible points to include in their composition.

• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: open mindedness and creativity as learner suggests ideas to complete a story.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation as learners in pairs, search and read compositions online.

Link to other Subjects:

Learners are able to relate the skill of creative writing to their learning in Kiswahili.

Suggested learning resources:
